panels.description: Alex's identity band flashes as the apartment door node turns amber. Keep upper display clear.
Alex tries the locked door while B11 watches from the workshop threshold. Keep upper door clear.
Bi11bot projects the infrastructure spine connecting Keel, Halyard and Oasis, with water, rail and data lines sharing the route. Keep upper projection clear.
Ada finds a narrow unwired service hatch behind the workshop shelving. Alex opens it with a manual latch; keep the upper hatch clear.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: Alpha controls movement, records and infrastructure. The workshop woke. Alpha noticed.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: It forgot the old service route.
